items.name: Breasts out (exposed breasts concept/helper)
items.description:
If you like this and wanna throw over some support, buy me a coffee.

This is a helper concept that will try to expose breasts without (hopefully) messing with the outfit and location as much. The existing "breasts out" and "exposed breasts" keywords, if they do work, tend to often throw out the outfits.

Keyword: breastsout

Strength: ~0.7 - 1.0

Usage: ... breastsout <lora:breastsout24_rvkwi:1> ...

Example: a woman in a blue dress standing in the snow, breastsout <lora:breastsout24_rvkwi:1>

I tried to make this more flexible and listen well. The keyword can also make it work against most negative prompts that would otherwise cancel the tokens. Like negative "big breasts" to get smaller ones, or "nudity" if an outfit is tricky to appear.

Trained on SD 1.5, tested in URPM 1.3 and Grapefruit v4, should work on most models.

I made 2 preview images with the keyword in it for auto if anyone wants them, it's the last 2 example images.
